Title: Why Yours Might Keep Coming Back - Nosebleed Habits to Watch

Description:
About 60% of Americans get a nosebleed at some point in their life - but if yours keep coming back, a few everyday habits could be part of the problem.

Allergy medication can dry out your nasal lining, airplane cabins run far drier than a normal room, and blowing your nose too hard puts pressure right where most nosebleeds start. None of these need a full lifestyle overhaul - small changes can cut down how often it happens.
